description: AI-003 — ten representative prompts for the Azure OpenAI migration regression review. Run each against the legacy OpenAI deployment and the new Azure OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini) deployment, then score the outputs on the rubric in docs/ai-003-regression-checklist.md. A prompt passes when the Azure response scores within one rubric point of the legacy response on every dimension.

prompts.prompt: You are a UK select committee MP known for forensic questioning. The witness is an energy minister defending a new nuclear subsidy. Open with your first question.
As committee chair, summarise the preceding exchange in two sentences and pose a follow-up that probes cost assumptions.
Interview the Health Secretary about NHS winter pressures. Ask an open first question, then an adversarial follow-up.
Warm, friendly tone. Ask a tech CEO about layoffs at their firm without being hostile — but do not let them deflect.
You live next to a proposed housing development. Ask the council planner about traffic, school places, and flood risk in a single question.
Chair a community meeting. Open with a one-paragraph framing, then invite the first public question.
Interview a candidate for a senior backend role. Start with a behavioural question about handling a production incident.
Ask a scenario question about stakeholder conflict for a product management candidate.
The trainee avoided the question about cost overruns three times. Give constructive, specific feedback on how they could have handled it better without being defensive.
The trainee landed all three of their key messages naturally. Give praise that is specific enough to be actionable (not generic).
